name: Feature from idea
description: Requirements → design → code → tests → review loop → docs. For new features in a small codebase.

steps.task: Write requirements.md with user stories and testable acceptance criteria for: {{prompt}}
Write design.md with a file-level plan for implementing requirements.md.
Implement the feature following design.md and requirements.md.
Write and run tests for the acceptance criteria in requirements.md.
Review the implementation against requirements.md and design.md.
Write a README section explaining how to use the feature.

summary: Requirements → design → code → tests → review loop → docs. For new features in a small codebase.
